address: Plantage Middenlaan 52, Amsterdam (Plantage, former Artis-side block): 2022 courtyard housing block of 294 homes, brick piers with stone balcony slabs and a zinc mansard
notes: Plantage Middenlaan 52 (BAG: built 2022; 294 dwellings, a health-care, a sport, an office and five other units; 6,543 m2 footprint, 22 m): a courtyard housing block on the site of the 1970s Plantage building (the 2018 panorama w01-210 shows that demolished building behind site fencing, so no south-west wall is cited). The new block is photographed on three walls: the north-east street front (w02-30, 2023-01-13: dark brown brick, tall vertical piers between narrow windows, cream stone balcony slabs with moulded edges and a continuous stone belt course over a high ground floor, a zinc mansard roof with dormers), the courtyard front (w03-30, 2025-06-19: the same grid in buff brick with glazed balcony rails) and the north-west front (w04-300, 2023-01-13: dark brick with deep cream balcony slabs on brick piers).

Modelled: three 6-storey groups (street front panels 8 and 6; courtyard panel 98 in buff brick; north-west panels 24 and 14) of narrow-window bays between brick piers under a stone cornice (a top parapet band in the photographs); six storeys rather than the seven counted in the photograph because a seventh storey leaves the last pier of panel 8 floating (no-floating-parts gate). Zinc roof as surveyed by 3DBAG LoD2.2. The cornice is also what attaches the last top-storey pier of panel 8 to the shell (gate no-floating-parts).

Simplified: the moulded stone slab edges are plain balcony slabs, balconies (layered kit: one slab, rail and pair of cheeks per balcony) are drawn on the street front only, in every third bay on storeys 2-4 as in w02-30; the courtyard and north-west balconies would exceed the 12k budget (11,997 triangles with the street front alone), the stone belt course over the ground floor is not drawn (the kit only offers a course on every storey line, which reads as a grid), the ground-floor double doors and recessed loggias are plain ground windows, the dormers are the 3DBAG roof geometry. Not modelled: the south-west and south-east walls and the inner courtyard walls other than panel 98 (no current photograph).

Uninstalled 2026-10-14 (likeness triage, plan Part 1 lane D): no archived crop matches any of the three street fronts (NO PHOTO; coverage 0.54, 0, 0.59 against the 0.60 match) on a ride-visible block (217 of 2,000 sampled routes), and the thumbnails (w01-210L, w03-30L, w07-120) show brick fronts with stacked cream curved balcony bands where the model draws mostly blank brown walls. Uninstalled until crops match; needs a curved balcony-band component.
